territorial_scope.description: Applies to federal public administration bodies and entities of Mexico and to Mexican export controls on dual-use goods, software and technologies.

evidence.quote: Las dependencias y entidades de la Administración Pública Federal asegurarán que los controles de México sean compatibles

summary.short: Amends Mexico's 2020 dual-use export control agreement by adding Articles XXVIII-XXX. Federal agencies must keep export controls compatible with Wassenaar, Australia Group, NSG and MTCR lists, and Mexico must update its annexes and adopt US additional controls on notification. In force the day after DOF publication.
summary.long: The instrument amends the Secretaría de Economía agreement published in the Diario Oficial de la Federación on 27 December 2020, which sets the tariff fractions of dual-use goods, software and technologies whose export is subject to Secretaría de Economía regulation, by adding Articles XXVIII, XXIX and XXX. Article XXVIII requires the federal public administration bodies and entities to ensure that Mexico's controls are compatible with the control lists of the Wassenaar Arrangement, the Australia Group, the Nuclear Suppliers Group and the Missile Technology Control Regime. Article XXIX requires Mexico to modify annexes I to VI of the agreement to be consistent with those agreed controls. Article XXX requires Mexico to update the agreement in a timely manner to adopt and maintain additional export controls in force in the United States, based on a written notification from that country. The operative provisions set no penalties or individual enforcement measures. The instrument enters into force the day after its publication in the Diario Oficial de la Federación. The recitals state that the Wassenaar Arrangement allows high-technology firms access to previously restricted inputs and production lines.

notes: Amending act adding Arts. XXVIII, XXIX and XXX to the parent Acuerdo of 27 Dec 2020 (as amended in 2022). The three new articles set commitments of federal agencies and of México; they name no private addressee, threshold or penalty. Entry into force the day after DOF publication (Transitorio ÚNICO). The text gives a dateline of 21 de mayo de 2026 but no DOF publication date; the registry's 03-07-2026 is metadata only, not verified in the text. The 2022 amendments mentioned in the Considerando are not amended by this act. Regime and US-notification targets have no registry IDs, so target_instrument_id is empty.
